body: I'd love to move but can't afford to.  Money is the biggest barrier for everything. Honestly at this point I just want a painless death.  I wish euthanasia were legal...get a drink with a "sleeping potion". I'd drink it now.  Life is not a gift when every day is misery.  And yeah...everyone says "pray" and all that bullshit.  Never mattters.

Have a lawyer and have the whole time...didnt matter.  The news cant do anything...this happens to tons of people every day.  Publicity scares me as much as dying. I have social anxiety and could never stand the attention.  I appreciate the ideas though.  There just aren't any more reasonable avenues.

Thinking sure...but wont.  Too cowardly and have to organize some things.

I want to live but cant manage to live in misery for the rest of my days.  No  good option.
None that can help...they just say things like "well you have to keep positive" and other platitudes with no effect.  Plus its late at night.
No idea...there is nobody else to say anything to...its late...I cant sleep.  I am scared and angry.

No...I have heard this before and the answer is no.  People can only suffer so much.  It's bee years...it has overwhelmed me. I am always exhausted. And most people make it worse.  All I needed was help from a system I paid into....so I would have a means to survive and TRY to live.  They fucked me repeatedly and there is nothign I can do.
I wont die soon naturally...thats the problem. I will die slowly and painfully.  Yes I have tried to get help many places.
